name: approval-and-charter
$comment: Two explicit hints captured from one comment; a human approves one. approvedOnly recall renders only the approved hint; a normal recall renders both. 400 days later the approved hint is immune to decay while the other retires; forget() removes the approved one for good.

turn.user: What is the tax treatment of a TFSA withdrawal?
turn.assistant: Withdrawals are not taxed... (disclaimer: this is not financial advice)

steps.note: One comment, two hints: disclaimers=omit (agent lane, constraint) and units=metric (responseStyle lane).

feedback.text: no disclaimers please, and use metric units

steps.note: A human approves the disclaimer rule. Approval never decays and is never auto-superseded.
approvedOnly: the strictly human-approved charter carries only the approved hint.

recall.text: How much can I contribute to my RRSP this year?

steps.note: A normal recall mixes approved and auto hints.

recall.text: How much can I contribute to my RRSP this year?

steps.note: 400 days pass. The auto hint (explicit, captured, 90 d half-life) decays to 0.5^4.4 ≈ 0.05 < 0.15 and retires; the approved one has no half-life.

recall.text: Should I hold bonds or an ETF in my portfolio?

steps.note: forget() hard-deletes the approved hint (approval does not protect against an explicit human forget).

recall.text: Should I hold bonds or an ETF in my portfolio?
